fields.Name: T171 - Testing Analytics Charts And Time Range
fields.Description: Renders the bespoke CSS-bar analytics surface + version-comparison table driven by SelectedDays time-range chips (OnTimeRangeSelect) — distinct from the AI Analytics dashboard and generic aggregates.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher next to the logo, choose "Testing", then click the "Analytics" tab. Verify the analytics view renders its sections: a Trend Overview (Pass Rate, Run Volume, Score, Cost bar charts), an Insights grid (Top Failing / Slowest / Most Expensive tests), a Score Distribution chart, and a Version Comparison table. Then click a different time-range filter chip (e.g. 7 / 30 / 90 days) and confirm the chip becomes active and the charts re-render for that window. Seeing the sections render (with data or valid empty states) and responding to the time-range change is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Analytics tab renders Trend Overview charts, an Insights grid, a Score Distribution chart, and a Version Comparison table (each with data or a valid empty state)
Clicking a time-range chip marks it active and re-renders the trend charts
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
